verses.text: Samuel talk to all Israel say, “Look, I don listen to una voice for everything wey una talk to me, and I don make one king reign over una.
Now look, di king dey waka before una. I don old and my hair don grey. Look, my pikin man dem dey with una. I don waka before una from my youth until dis day.

Look, I dey here. Testify against me before di Lord and before im anointed. Whose ox I take? Whose donkey I take? Who I cheat? Who I oppress? From whose hand I receive bribe to blind my eyes with am? I go return am to una.”
Dem talk say, “You no cheat us, and you no oppress us, and you no take anything from anybody hand.”
E talk to dem say, “Di Lord na witness against una, and im anointed na witness dis day, say una no find anything for my hand.” Dem talk say, “E na witness.”
Samuel talk to di people say, “Di Lord na di one wey appoint Moses and Aaron, and wey bring una papa dem up out of di land of Egypt.
So now stand still, so that I go reason with una before di Lord concerning all di righteous acts of di Lord, wey e do to una and to una papa dem.
When Jacob come into Egypt, and una papa dem cry to di Lord, di Lord send Moses and Aaron, and dem bring una papa dem out of Egypt, and make dem dwell for dis place.
But dem forget di Lord, dem God. E sell dem into di hand of Sisera, captain of di army of Hazor, and into di hand of di Philistines, and into di hand of di king of Moab. Dem fight against dem.
Dem cry to di Lord, and talk say, ‘We don sin, because we don leave di Lord, and don serve di Baals and di Ashtaroth. But now deliver us out of di hand of our enemies, and we go serve you.’
Di Lord send Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and deliver una out of di hand of una enemies on every side, and una dwell safe.
When una see say Nahash di king of di pikin dem of Ammon come against una, una talk to me say, ‘No, but one king must reign over us,’ when di Lord una God na una king.
Now look, di king wey una choose, wey una ask for! Look, di Lord don set one king over una.
If una fear di Lord, and serve am, and obey im voice, and no rebel against di commandment of di Lord, and both una and di king wey dey reign over una dey follow di Lord una God, e go be well.
But if una no obey di voice of di Lord, but rebel against di commandment of di Lord, den di hand of di Lord go dey against una, as e dey against una papa dem.
Now so, stand still and see dis great thing, wey di Lord go do before una eyes.

Na wheat harvest time now, no be so? I go call to di Lord, and e go send thunder and rain. Una go know and see say una wickedness dey great, wey una do for di sight of di Lord, by asking for one king for una self.”
So Samuel call to di Lord, and di Lord send thunder and rain dat day. All di people fear di Lord and Samuel plenty.
All di people talk to Samuel say, “Pray for your servants to di Lord your God, so that we no go die, because we don add dis evil to all our sins, to ask for one king for us.”
Samuel talk to di people say, “No fear. Una don do all dis evil, yet no turn aside from following di Lord, but serve di Lord with all una heart.
No turn aside, because den una go go after vain things wey no fit profit or deliver, because dem na vain.
Because di Lord no go forsake im people because of im great name, because e don please di Lord to make una im people.
As for me, e no fit be say I go sin against di Lord by stopping to pray for una. I go teach una di good and di right way.
Only fear di Lord, and serve am in truth with all una heart, because una think about di great things wey e don do for una.
But if una still do wickedness, una go perish, both una and una king.”
Saul don reign one year, and when e don reign two years over Israel,

Saul choose 3,000 men of Israel for imself. 2,000 dey with Saul for Michmash and for di hill country of Bethel, and 1,000 dey with Jonathan for Gibeah of Benjamin. Di rest of di people e send go dem tents, every man.
Jonathan strike di garrison of di Philistines wey dey Geba, and di Philistines hear am. Saul blow di trumpet throughout all di land, talk say, “Make di Hebrews hear.”
All Israel hear say Saul don strike di garrison of di Philistines, and also say Israel don become hateful to di Philistines. Di people gather together after Saul to Gilgal.

Di Philistines gather together to fight with Israel: 30,000 chariots, and 6,000 horsemen, and people wey plenty like di sand wey dey di seashore. Dem come up, and camp for Michmash, east of Beth Aven.
When di men of Israel see say dem dey for trouble, because di people dey distressed, di people hide for caves, and for thickets, and among di rocks, and for strongholds, and for pits.
Some of di Hebrews cross di Jordan to di land of Gad and Gilead. Saul still dey for Gilgal, and all di people dey follow am dey tremble.
E wait seven days, according to di set time wey Samuel set, but Samuel no come to Gilgal. Di people dey scatter from am.
Saul talk say, “Bring come burnt offering to me, and di peace offerings.” E offer di burnt offering.
E happen say as soon as e finish to offer di burnt offering, look, Samuel come. Saul go out to meet am, so that e go greet am.
Samuel talk say, “Wetin you don do?” Saul talk say, “Because I see say di people dey scatter from me, and you no come within di days wey you appoint, and di Philistines gather together for Michmash,
so I talk say, ‘Now di Philistines go come down on me to Gilgal, and I never ask di Lord for favour.’ So I force myself, and offer di burnt offering.”
Samuel talk to Saul say, “You don do foolishly. You no keep di commandment of di Lord your God, wey e command you. Because for dis time, di Lord go don establish your kingdom over Israel forever.
But now your kingdom no go continue. Di Lord don seek for imself one man after im own heart, and di Lord don appoint am to be prince over im people, because you no keep wetin di Lord command you.”
Samuel rise, and go up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul count di people wey dey with am, about 600 men.
Saul, and Jonathan im pikin man, and di people wey dey with dem, stay for Geba of Benjamin, but di Philistines camp for Michmash.
Raiders come out of di camp of di Philistines in three companies. One company turn to di way wey go Ophrah, to di land of Shual,
and another company turn to di way to Beth Horon, and another company turn to di way of di border wey look over di valley of Zeboim toward di wilderness.
Now no blacksmith dey find for all di land of Israel, because di Philistines talk say, “Make di Hebrews no make swords or spears.”
But all Israel go down to di Philistines, to sharpen every man im ploughshare, im mattock, im axe, and im sickle,
yet dem get one file for di mattocks, and for di ploughshares, and for di forks, and for di axes, and to set di goads.
So e happen for di day of battle say no sword or spear dey find for di hand of any of di people wey dey with Saul and Jonathan, but Saul and Jonathan im pikin man get dem.
Di garrison of di Philistines go out to di pass of Michmash.
Dat day, e happen say Jonathan di pikin of Saul talk to di young man wey carry im armour say, “Come, make we cross over to di Philistines garrison wey dey di other side.” But e no tell im papa.
Saul dey stay for di outskirts of Gibeah under di pomegranate tree wey dey Migron. Di people wey dey with am na about 600 men,
and Ahijah, di pikin of Ahitub, Ichabod brother, di pikin of Phinehas, di pikin of Eli, di priest of di Lord for Shiloh, dey wear ephod. Di people no know say Jonathan don go.

Between di passes, by wey Jonathan seek to go over to di Philistines garrison, one sharp rock dey for di one side, and one sharp rock for di other side. Di name of di one na Bozez, and di name of di other na Seneh.
Di one crag dey north before Michmash, and di other south before Geba.

Jonathan talk to di young man wey carry im armour say, “Come, make we cross over to di garrison of dis uncircumcised. E fit be say di Lord go work for us, because nothing dey wey fit stop di Lord to save by plenty or by few.”
Im armour bearer talk to am say, “Do all wey dey your heart. Go, look, I dey with you, as your heart be.”
Jonathan talk say, “Look, we go cross over to di men, and we go show ourselves to dem.
If dem talk to us say, ‘Wait until we reach una,’ den we go stand still for our place, and no go up to dem.
But if dem talk say, ‘Come up to us,’ den we go go up, because di Lord don deliver dem into our hand. Dis go be di sign to us.”
Di two of dem appear before di garrison of di Philistines. Di Philistines talk say, “Look, di Hebrews dey come out of di holes wey dem hide.”

Di men of di garrison answer Jonathan and im armour bearer, talk say, “Come up to us, and we go show una something.” Jonathan talk to im armour bearer say, “Come up after me, because di Lord don deliver dem into di hand of Israel.”
Jonathan climb up on im hands and on im feet, and im armour bearer follow am. Dem fall before Jonathan, and im armour bearer kill dem after am.
Dat first slaughter, wey Jonathan and im armour bearer make, na about 20 men, within about half furrow of one acre of land.
Terror dey for di camp, for di field, and among all di people. Di garrison and di raiders also tremble, and di earth quake, so e become very great trembling.
Di watchmen of Saul for Gibeah of Benjamin look, and look, di multitude dey melt away, dey go dis way and dat way.
Saul talk to di people wey dey with am say, “Count now, and see who don go from us.” When dem count, look, Jonathan and im armour bearer no dey.
Saul talk to Ahijah say, “Bring di ark of God here.” Because di ark of God dey dat time with di pikin dem of Israel.
While Saul dey talk to di priest, di noise wey dey for di camp of di Philistines continue and increase. Saul talk to di priest say, “Withdraw your hand.”
Saul and all di people wey dey with am gather together, and come to di battle. Look, every man sword dey against im neighbour, and e be very great confusion.
Di Hebrews wey dey with di Philistines before, wey go up with dem to di camp from all around, even dem also turn go join Israel wey dey with Saul and Jonathan.
Likewise all di men of Israel wey hide for di hill country of Ephraim, when dem hear say di Philistines run, even dem also follow dem close for di battle.
So di Lord save Israel dat day, and di battle pass Beth Aven.

Di men of Israel dey distressed dat day, but Saul put di people under oath say, “Cursed be di man wey eat any food until evening, so that I go avenge myself on my enemies.” So none of di people taste any food.
All di people come into di forest, and honey dey for di ground.
When di people come into di forest, look, di honey dey drip, but nobody put im hand to im mouth, because di people fear di oath.
But Jonathan no hear when im papa charge di people with di oath, so e stretch out di end of di rod wey dey im hand, and dip am inside di honeycomb, and put im hand to im mouth, and im eyes brighten.
Den one of di people answer, talk say, “Your papa strictly charge di people with oath, talk say, ‘Cursed be di man wey eat any food dis day.’ And di people dey faint.”
Den Jonathan talk say, “My papa don trouble di land. See how my eyes don brighten, because I taste small of dis honey.
E for better pass if di people eat freely today of di plunder of dem enemies wey dem find! Because now, di slaughter among di Philistines no great.”
Dem strike di Philistines dat day from Michmash to Aijalon. Di people dey very faint.
Di people fly upon di plunder, and take sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slaughter dem on di ground. Di people eat dem with di blood.
Den dem tell Saul say, “Look, di people dey sin against di Lord, because dem dey eat with di blood.” E talk say, “You don act with treachery. Roll one great stone to me dis day.”

Saul talk say, “Scatter among di people, and talk to dem say, ‘Bring me here every man im ox, and every man im sheep, and slaughter dem here, and eat. No sin against di Lord by eating with di blood.’” So all di people bring every man im ox with am dat night, and slaughter dem dere.
Saul build one altar to di Lord. Dis na di first altar wey e build to di Lord.

Saul talk say, “Make we go down after di Philistines by night, and plunder dem until di morning light, and make we no leave one man of dem.” Dem talk say, “Do whatever seem good to you.” Den di priest talk say, “Make we draw near here to God.”
Saul ask God say, “I suppose go down after di Philistines? You go deliver dem into di hand of Israel?” But God no answer am dat day.
Saul talk say, “Draw near here, all una chiefs of di people, and know and see wetin be dis sin dis day.
For as di Lord dey live, wey save Israel, even if e dey Jonathan my pikin man, e must surely die.” But nobody among all di people answer am.
Den e talk to all Israel say, “Una dey one side, and I and Jonathan my pikin man go dey di other side.” Di people talk to Saul say, “Do wetin seem good to you.”
Therefore Saul talk to di Lord, di God of Israel, say, “Give di perfect lot.” Dem take Saul and Jonathan by lot, but di people go free.
Saul talk say, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my pikin man.” Dem take Jonathan.
Den Saul talk to Jonathan say, “Tell me wetin you don do.” Jonathan tell am say, “I taste small honey with di end of di rod wey dey my hand. Look, I dey here. I must die.”
Saul talk say, “God do so and more also, because you must surely die, Jonathan.”

Di people talk to Saul say, “Jonathan suppose die, wey don work dis great salvation for Israel? E no fit be so! As di Lord dey live, no even one hair of im head go fall to di ground, because e don work with God dis day.” So di people rescue Jonathan, so e no die.
Den Saul go up from following di Philistines, and di Philistines go to dem own place.

Now when Saul take di kingdom over Israel, e fight against all im enemies on every side, against Moab, and against di pikin dem of Ammon, and against Edom, and against di kings of Zobah, and against di Philistines. Wherever e turn, e defeat dem.
E do valiantly, and strike di Amalekites, and deliver Israel out of di hand of dem wey plunder dem.
Di pikin man dem of Saul na Jonathan, and Ishvi, and Malchishua. Di names of im two pikin woman dem: di name of di firstborn na Merab, and di name of di younger na Michal.
Di name of Saul wife na Ahinoam di pikin woman of Ahimaaz. Di name of di captain of im army na Abner di pikin of Ner, Saul uncle.
Kish na Saul papa, and Ner, Abner papa, na di pikin of Abiel.
Di war strong against di Philistines all di days of Saul. When Saul see any strong man, or any brave man, e take am to imself.
Samuel talk to Saul say, “Di Lord send me to anoint you to be king over im people, over Israel. Now listen to di voice of di words of di Lord.
Dis na wetin di Lord of Armies talk: ‘I don consider wetin Amalek do to Israel, how dem lay wait for am for di way, when e come up out of Egypt.
Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all wey dem get, and no spare dem, but kill both man and woman, small pikin and baby wey dey suck, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”
Saul summon di people, and number dem for Telaim: 200,000 footmen, and 10,000 men of Judah.
Saul come to di city of Amalek, and lay wait for di valley.

Saul talk to di Kenites say, “Go, depart, go down from among di Amalekites, so that I no destroy una with dem, because una show kindness to all di pikin dem of Israel, when dem come up out of Egypt.” So di Kenites depart from among di Amalekites.
Saul strike di Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, wey dey east of Egypt.
E take Agag di king of di Amalekites alive, and utterly destroy all di people with di edge of di sword.

But Saul and di people spare Agag, and di best of di sheep, and of di oxen, and of di fat calves, and di lambs, and all wey good, and no utterly destroy dem. But everything wey vile and worthless, dem utterly destroy dat one.
Di word of di Lord come to Samuel, talk,
“E grieve me say I don set up Saul to be king, because e don turn back from following me, and no perform my commandments.” Samuel dey angry, and e cry to di Lord all night.
Samuel rise early to meet Saul for di morning. Dem tell Samuel say, “Saul come to Carmel, and look, e set up one monument for imself, and don turn, and pass on, and go down to Gilgal.”
Samuel come to Saul, and Saul talk to am say, “Blessed be you of di Lord! I don perform di commandment of di Lord.”
Samuel talk say, “Den wetin be dis bleating of di sheep for my ears, and di lowing of di oxen wey I dey hear?”
Saul talk say, “Dem don bring dem from di Amalekites, because di people spare di best of di sheep and of di oxen, to sacrifice to di Lord your God. Di rest we don utterly destroy.”
Den Samuel talk to Saul say, “Stop! I go tell you wetin di Lord don talk to me dis night.” E talk to am say, “Talk on.”
Samuel talk say, “Even though you dey small for your own eyes, you no be di head of di tribes of Israel? Di Lord anoint you king over Israel.
Di Lord send you on a journey, and talk say, ‘Go, and utterly destroy di sinners, di Amalekites, and fight against dem until dem finish.’
Why you no obey di voice of di Lord, but fly upon di plunder, and do evil for di sight of di Lord?”
Saul talk to Samuel say, “But I don obey di voice of di Lord, and don go di way wey di Lord send me, and don bring Agag di king of Amalek, and don utterly destroy di Amalekites.
But di people take of di plunder, sheep and oxen, di best of di devoted things, to sacrifice to di Lord your God for Gilgal.”
Samuel talk say, “Di Lord get as great delight for burnt offerings and sacrifices, as for obeying di voice of di Lord? Look, to obey better pass sacrifice, and to listen pass di fat of rams.
Because rebellion na like di sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness na like idolatry and teraphim. Because you don reject di word of di Lord, e don also reject you from being king.”
Saul talk to Samuel say, “I don sin, because I don transgress di commandment of di Lord, and your words, because I fear di people, and obey dem voice.
Now therefore, I beg you, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, so that I go worship di Lord.”
Samuel talk to Saul say, “I no go return with you, because you don reject di word of di Lord, and di Lord don reject you from being king over Israel.”
As Samuel turn about to go away, Saul seize di skirt of im robe, and e tear.
Samuel talk to am say, “Di Lord don tear di kingdom of Israel from you dis day, and don give am to your neighbour wey better pass you.
Also di Strength of Israel no go lie or repent, because e no be man wey suppose repent.”
Den e talk say, “I don sin. Yet honour me now, I beg you, before di elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, so that I go worship di Lord your God.”
So Samuel turn again after Saul, and Saul worship di Lord.
Den Samuel talk say, “Bring Agag di king of di Amalekites here to me.” Agag come to am cheerfully. Agag talk say, “Surely di bitterness of death don pass.”
Samuel talk say, “As your sword don make women childless, so your mama go be childless among women.” Samuel cut Agag to pieces before di Lord for Gilgal.
Den Samuel go to Ramah, and Saul go up to im house for Gibeah of Saul.
Samuel no see Saul again until di day of im death, but Samuel mourn for Saul. Di Lord grieve say e don make Saul king over Israel.

Di Lord talk to Samuel say, “How long you go mourn for Saul, seeing say I don reject am from reigning over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I go send you to Jesse di Bethlehemite, because I don provide one king for myself among im pikin man dem.”
Samuel talk say, “How I fit go? If Saul hear am, e go kill me.” Di Lord talk say, “Take one heifer with you, and talk say, ‘I don come to sacrifice to di Lord.’
Call Jesse to di sacrifice, and I go show you wetin you go do. You go anoint for me di one wey I name to you.”
Samuel do wetin di Lord talk, and come to Bethlehem. Di elders of di town come to meet am dey tremble, and talk say, “You come in peace?”
E talk say, “In peace. I don come to sacrifice to di Lord. Make una self holy, and come with me to di sacrifice.” E make Jesse and im pikin man dem holy, and call dem to di sacrifice.
When dem come, e look at Eliab, and talk say, “Surely di Lord anointed dey before am.”

But di Lord talk to Samuel say, “No look at im face, or at di height of im body, because I don reject am. Because di Lord no see as man dey see. Man dey look at di outward appearance, but di Lord dey look at di heart.”
Jesse call Abinadab, and make am pass before Samuel. E talk say, “Di Lord no choose dis one either.”
Den Jesse make Shammah pass by. E talk say, “Di Lord no choose dis one either.”
Jesse make seven of im pikin man dem pass before Samuel. Samuel talk to Jesse say, “Di Lord no choose dem.”

Samuel talk to Jesse say, “Na all di young men be dis?” E talk say, “Di youngest still remain, and look, e dey keep di sheep.” Samuel talk to Jesse say, “Send and bring am, because we no go sit down until e come here.”
E send, and bring am in. Now e dey ruddy, with beautiful eyes, and good to look at. Di Lord talk say, “Rise, anoint am, because dis na im.”
Den Samuel take di horn of oil, and anoint am for di middle of im brothers. Di Lord Spirit come on David with power from dat day go on. So Samuel rise up, and go to Ramah.
Now di Lord Spirit depart from Saul, and one evil spirit from di Lord trouble am.
Saul servants talk to am say, “Look now, one evil spirit from God dey trouble you.

Make our oga now command im servants wey dey before am to find one man wey fit play skillfully on di harp. E go happen say when di evil spirit from God dey on you, e go play with im hand, and you go dey well.”
Saul talk to im servants say, “Find me now one man wey fit play well, and bring am to me.”

Den one of di young men answer, talk say, “Look, I don see one pikin man of Jesse di Bethlehemite, wey know how to play, and e na strong brave man, one man of war, wise for speech, and handsome person, and di Lord dey with am.”
So Saul send messengers to Jesse, and talk say, “Send me David your pikin man, wey dey with di sheep.”
Jesse take one donkey loaded with bread, and one skin of wine, and one kid, and send dem by David im pikin man to Saul.
David come to Saul, and stand before am. Saul love am plenty, and e become im armour bearer.
Saul send to Jesse, talk say, “Make David stand before me, because e don find favour for my sight.”
E happen say when di evil spirit from God dey on Saul, David go take di harp, and play with im hand. So Saul go dey refreshed, and dey well, and di evil spirit go depart from am.
